aka: Ven Known Meier (Ancestry tree placeholder for Henery Meier's wife)
summary: John's 4th great-grandmother; an orphan born illegitimately in Munzingen c.1798.
bio: Juliana Senn was born about 1798 (22 in Oct 1820) at Munzingen, the illegitimate daughter of Juliana Senn (the elder), who had died by 1820 — the 1820 entry calls her a 'parentless local citizen's daughter'. She married Heinrich Mayer on 16 Oct 1820 and lived in house No. 68. FS index spellings: 'Julianna Sann' (QP3C-SCW6), 'Juliana Senn', 'Julianaa Senn'. The German-origins reader read the 1835 entry's mother's surname as 'B[onn?]' (ink blot); Senn is preferred. Death not found.
sources: Landesarchiv Baden-Württemberg, Staatsarchiv Freiburg, L 10 Nr. 1590 (Munzingen, Catholic parish, civil-register duplicates/Standesbücher 1810–1839; 549 images; record id 5-480946), marriages 1820 No. 3 http://www.landesarchiv-bw.de/plink/?f=5-480946-215
